ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a transition-state structural formula, containing several curved arrows; on the left is an aromatic six-membered ring/fused fragment, in the middle there is a carbon site labeled H, below it is connected to a heteroatom fragment labeled NH; on the right is a cyclohexyl fragment, and it bears an external C=N/NH2+ type connection. The curved arrows in the figure only indicate electron movement and are not counted as bonds; all bonds involving hydrogen are also not counted. Reasoning: According to the meaning of the problem, first ignore the curved arrows and all H connections. In the left fused aromatic/heteroatom fragment, count the unique heavy atom—heavy atom bonds one by one, and note that the ring edge at the fused position cannot be counted repeatedly; this part has 10 non-hydrogen bonds in total. In the right cyclohexyl/iminium fragment, continue to count only bonds between heavy atoms, including the C=N/NH2+ connection, but do not count N-H bonds; this part has 5 non-hydrogen bonds in total. Adding the two parts gives 10 + 5 = 15.

method.method_draft: First visually suppress all curved arrows and all H attachments. Count unique non-H bonds in the left fused aromatic/heteroatom fragment, making sure each ring edge is counted once even where rings share atoms/bonds. Then count the remaining non-H bonds in the right cyclohexyl/iminium fragment, including the C=N/NH2+ connection but not N-H bonds. Add the two subtotals; the left/fused portion contributes 10 heavy-atom bonds and the right/iminium portion contributes 5 more, giving 15.
method.CoT_raw:

推理：按照题意先忽略弯曲箭头和所有 H 连接。左侧稠合芳香/杂原子片段中，逐一数唯一的重原子—重原子键，并注意稠合处的环边不能重复计数，该部分共有 10 个非氢键。右侧环己基/亚胺鎓片段中，继续只数重原子间的键，包括 C=N/NH2+ 连接，但不数 N-H 键，该部分共有 5 个非氢键。两部分相加为 10 + 5 = 15。
